parole.significato: On Rapa Nui, a stone platform on which moai (statues) were erected.
One of the large stone statues on Easter Island (Rapa Nui).
parole.testo: Borrowed from Rapa Nui mo'ai (“statue, figurine”).

parole.significato: A cylinder of red scoria mounted as a separate piece on the head of a moai, in the manner of a hat or topknot.
The native Polynesian inhabitants of Easter Island.
parole.testo: From Rapa Nui Rapa Nui (“big Rapa”).

parole.significato: A crescent-shaped pectoral ornament once worn by the women of Easter Island.
An early glyphic writing system of Easter Island, written in reverse boustrophedon and as yet undeciphered.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Rapa Nui roŋoroŋo (“to recite, chant”), a reduplicated form of roŋo (“message”).
